	<Forecast>Cloudy. Very high chance of snow showers, becoming less likely late this afternoon and evening. Damaging winds possible. Winds westerly 35 to 55 km/h tending southwesterly 30 to 35 km/h in the early afternoon then tending southerly in the late evening.</Forecast>
	<ResortReportHeadline>A day for the Storm Riders.</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>Thanks for letting me take this one Bill. The storm arrived, intensifying overnight and this morning we've woken up to 10cms on the stakes with the potential for more fresh cms to pile up before lifts open.</p><p>Right now it's blowing and still snowing. I suspect the wind gauge has frozen up on the weather station but it's definitely strong from the West, which may ease later. The temp is currently -5.2 with the windchill making it feel much colder in exposed areas. It's a real mountain day.</p><p>It'll be a morning for the storm riders. Keep an eye on upper lift status as I reckon some may be hampered by the strong winds, particularly early on. With the cold temps the snow has dried right out and will be great in the open areas. With wind transport, some areas will be deeper than others. Seek out the more sheltered zones for the best accumulation.</p><p>While the overnight snowfall will have helped HV, be sure to take note of ropes and signage before launching in. Some areas have been upgraded in difficulty and are still thin with sharks lurking just beneath the surface waiting to catch out the over zealous.</p><p>The Extreme Area remains closed so please stay out. There'll be heaps better turns to be found elsewhere anyway.</p><p>Get out there and rip it up!</p><p>Cheers, Burner.&nbsp;</p></ResortReport>
